name: arrow_impact_ground
for: archer / bounty_echo arrows that miss or the low arrow striking the floor
notes: The arrow driven into the ground at a shallow angle (head buried, nock up-left, so it came from the left: mirror for shots going -x): it quivers for 5 frames (the nock end shakes 1 px), a lip of dirt round the entry, grit chunks thrown up that bounce and settle, a dust puff rising; the arrow then sits and breaks away at the end (1 s). Anchor = the point on the ground where it went in.
